local.decisionRule: One pooled 1000-game sample with rejection-only <50% looks at 300/500; final pass only at >=55% of 1000. No early pass, extensions, retuning or retries.
local.legacyLabelRole: Raw report v3/CI labels are historical diagnostics; only practical-v4 assess controls the local verdict.

process.timingCaveat: A null responseMs means no completed response was observed by the deadline. sendMs includes host input preparation/write/flush; consumerMs includes host-side consumption timing. Aggregate IO latency cannot be attributed solely to bot CPU or allocation behavior.

boss.historicalProtocolStatus: canonical boss identity corrected; all requests and outcomes retained
boss.interpretation: Practical score filter on reused known maps; no claim of statistical improvement.
limitations: Unchanged public boss/league IDs do not prove unchanged hidden boss implementation or execution conditions.
Known map/control outcomes can influence development; this panel is not fresh confirmation.
